about: The review-comment rules, in one place. The local app (review_store.py) and the browser and hosted Worker (web/review-core.js) both read this file; tests/fixtures/review-rule-cases.json holds the cases both must answer the same way.

messages.rangeEnd: Range end must follow start and be inside the video
messages.text: Please enter a comment (up to 10,000 characters)
messages.author: Author must be "you" or "ai"
messages.notYourComment: Only the reviewer's own comments can be edited
messages.wordIds: Invalid word IDs: one request can cover up to 2,000 words.
messages.timeFormat: Use h:mm:ss.mmm, m:ss.mmm, seconds or milliseconds
messages.videoIdFormat: Use letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore for the id
messages.videoIdTaken: That id already exists; use a new id for a new cut
messages.fps: fps must be a positive number
messages.transcriptChanged: The transcript changed while this was saving (a new render or an import), so this edit was not saved. Select the words again.
